commands.title: Search wiki
commands.description: Full-text search of this project's wiki (title > headings > body, any case, every word must match). The wiki is the project's knowledge base the user reads: how subsystems work, why things were decided, examples. Search it before you explore a subsystem; it may already explain it. A page with stale true explains code that changed on the default branch after it was written: check it against the code and refresh it with wiki_write. Fails with no wiki here in the home workspace.

shadow.description: Also search the agents' own notes under .agents/.

limit.description: At most this many hits; default 20, max 100.

snippet.description: The first matching line, at most 160 characters.

commands.title: List wiki pages
commands.description: List this project's wiki pages by path, with title, last change, who made it and whether the page is stale. Fails with no wiki here in the home workspace.

shadow.description: Also list the agents' own notes under .agents/.

title.description: First # heading (an .html page's <title>), else the file name.

stale.description: A source the page explains changed on the default branch after it was written.

commands.title: Read wiki page
commands.description: Read one wiki page: its content and metadata. Fails with bad page path, not a page, not found or no wiki here.

page.description: Page path inside the wiki, e.g. sdui/components.md or .agents/test-app-traps.md.

stale.description: A source changed on the default branch after the page was written.

path.description: Absolute path of the page file.

commands.title: Write wiki page
commands.description: Create or replace a page of this project's wiki and commit it; every session and branch sees it at once. Pages are topics the user reads, updated in place, not logs: after you finish a feature or a decision, read the topic page (how it works, why it was decided so) and write it back updated, with sources, rather than adding a page per session. Your own traps, recipes and private notes go under .agents/ (hidden from the user by default). Markdown (.md, .markdown), mermaid (.mmd) or, for an example that must run, ONE self-contained .html page: inline CSS and JS, libraries only from cdnjs.cloudflare.com, cdn.jsdelivr.net, unpkg.com or esm.sh, no network calls, no iframes or forms (same rules as docs_open). No front matter. Link pages with relative Markdown links; link code by its absolute path in the repo's main checkout. Never write secrets, tokens or passwords. Fails with bad page path, not a page, too large (over 4 MiB) or no wiki here.

page.description: Page path inside the wiki, e.g. sdui/components.md; folders group pages; .agents/… for your own notes. No .. or absolute paths.

summary.description: One line on what changed; the commit message.

sources.description: Repo paths (relative to your worktree) the page explains; the page shows as stale when one of them changes on the default branch later.

path.description: Absolute path of the page file.

commands.title: Delete wiki page
commands.confirm: Delete this wiki page? It stays in the wiki's git history.
commands.description: Delete a wiki page; it stays in the wiki's git history. Fails with bad page path, not a page, not found or no wiki here.

commands.title: Wiki page history
commands.description: Changes of a wiki page, newest first.
